Class AssertionChecking

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.exceptions.AssertionChecking

  • public abstract class AssertionChecking
extends java.lang.Object

      • checkImplementationInvariant

        public static boolean checkImplementationInvariant(boolean invariantExpression,
                                                   java.lang.Class<?> definingClass,
                                                   java.lang.Object instance,
                                                   java.lang.String message)
        check an implementation invariant expression and print a message if the expression evaluates to false.

        Contract

         pre     definingClass != null
 pre     instance == null || definingClass.isAssignableFrom(instance.getClass())
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        invariantExpression - result of the invariant expression.
        definingClass - class defining the invariant expression.
        instance - instance on which the invariant is checked.
        message - message to be printed on stdout if invariantExpression is false.
        Returns:
        the value of invariantExpression.

      • assertNonNullOrThrow

        public static <T> T assertNonNullOrThrow(T value,
                                         java.util.function.Supplier<? extends VerboseException> exceptionFactory)
        assert that value is not null or throw the exception provided by exceptionFactory; meant to be used as an assert expression (rather than the standard Java assert instruction).

        Contract

         pre     exceptionFactory != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Type Parameters:
        T - type of the value to be tested and returned.
        Parameters:
        value - value to be asserted non null.
        exceptionFactory - supplier of an exception to be thrown if value is null.
        Returns:
        value if it is not null.

        public static boolean assertTrueOrThrow(boolean expression,

        assert that expression is true or throw the exception provided by exceptionFactory; meant to be used as an assert expression (rather than the standard Java assert instruction).

        Contract

         pre     exceptionFactory != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:

        exceptionFactory - supplier of an exception to be thrown if expression is false.
        Returns:

      • assertTrueAndReturnOrThrow

        public static <T> T assertTrueAndReturnOrThrow(boolean expression,
                                               T value,
                                               java.util.function.Supplier<? extends VerboseException> exceptionFactory)
        assert that expression is true and then return value otherwise throw the exception provided byexceptionFactory.

        Contract

         pre     exceptionFactory != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Type Parameters:
        T - type of the value to be tested and returned.
        Parameters:
        expression - boolean expression; if true, return value, otherwise throw the exception supplied by exceptionFactory.
        value - value to be returned if expression is true.
        exceptionFactory - supplier of an exception to be thrown if expression is false.
        Returns:
        value if expression is true.
